title: Off the grid
description: A cobalt-and-orange admission ticket tears along its perforation, leaving a stamped keepsake.
useCase: Make an occasional admission, reveal or redemption feel tangible without slowing down a frequent action.
interaction: Pull the stub right, or select Tear ticket
reducedMotion: The stub disappears and the admission stamp appears immediately. Drag distance still determines intent, with a single-click alternative.
limitations: Admission is local demo state. Use an authoritative server response before showing a successful real-world redemption; this gesture is not a security or payment mechanism.
look: Saturated cobalt page with an orange admission ticket in heavy, tightly tracked cobalt type, a barcode, monospace details and a dashed perforated stub.
motion: Dragging the stub right slides and tilts it; releasing past 65 px flings it down-right as it fades, while a tilted stamp scales in (240 ms); shorter pulls snap back.
adapt: The drag lives in the stub's `onPointerDown`, `onPointerMove` and `onPointerUp`: `pull` (clamped to 125) drives `translateX(${pull * 0.65}px)` plus rotation, and `pullRef.current >= 65` commits. Tune the `.sf-ticket-stub` and `.sf-ticket-stamp` transitions; replace the copy and gate `setAdmitted` on a server response.
